**Claude finished @cmungall's task in 10m 16s** —— [View job](https://github.com/ai4curation/ai-gene-review/actions/runs/42370870238)

---
### Review: PR #6198 — Comparative Mla phospholipid transport audit

- [x] Gather context (diff scope, changed curation artifacts)
- [x] Load `aigr-pr-review` skill and follow its procedure
- [x] Verify PMIDs, publication titles and `supporting_text` quotes (spot-checked)
- [x] Verify PANTHER family ids / labels / representative members
- [x] Verify the PDB→UniProt identity claim independently
- [x] Check GO term accuracy, specificity and action justification
- [x] Review core functions and module/variant modeling
- [x] Post review + set PR review status

> ⚠️ I could not run `just validate` / `just validate-families` — `uv` is unavailable and `python3` is blocked in this sandbox, so no dependency install was possible. Per the skill I'm trusting validation for deterministic checks and reviewing the non-deterministic part. `Build and test` was still `in_progress` when I finished. Everything below was verified by reading the frozen artifacts, `interpro/panther/panther.obo`, the UniProt flat files and the cached publications directly.

### Summary checklist
- [ ] Schema validation passes — *not runnable here; PR reports `just validate-all` PASS on `b005dd670c`, CI pending*
- [x] All PMIDs verified as real — 7 new `publications/PMID_*.md` are machine-fetched with matching titles
- [x] Supporting text matches publication content — ~12 quotes spot-checked verbatim (incl. across line wraps)
- [x] GO terms correct and specific
- [x] Review actions well-justified
- [x] Core functions accurately identified
- [ ] No over-annotation issues missed — see 🟡 #1 and #3

This is strong work, and several things I expected to be weak points held up under direct checking:

- **The PDB identity claim is real.** I re-derived it: both `11HY` and `11IF` polymer entities are `MAHHHHHH` + an exact 181-residue match to `Q7VSZ6` residues 27–207 (the mature sequence after the 1–26 signal peptide), with a `PEF` (DPPE) ligand. The module and `BP3761` correctly scope this as binding evidence, not native flux, and flag that the deposit is "To be published".
- **Every PANTHER id/label pair is verbatim-correct** against `panther.obo`, and every `representative_members` accession is confirmed in its own UniProt PANTHER cross-reference — including the surprising-but-correct `PTHR30188:SF4` = "PROTEIN TRIGALACTOSYLDIACYLGLYCEROL 1, CHLOROPLASTIC". The one exception, `Q88P90` (PSEPK Ttg2E), is exactly as the module description says: the cached flatfile predates the assignment, and the frozen `family-consultation/Q88P90-uniprot.json` snapshot does carry `PTHR35849:SF1`.
- **`GO:1990531` → `GO:0043190` is the right call** across `mlaD`/`mlaE`/`PTHR30188` — the term really is a P4-ATPase flippase complex and MlaFEDB really is an ABC system; I checked the frozen QuickGO payload.
- **The `enables GO:0120014` → `contributes_to` treatment is principled and uniform**, and the `GO:0120014` definition quoted in the reasons matches `GO_0120014.json` word for word.
- **Protein-binding `REMOVE`s** keep the interaction explicit in `reason`, and the `NEW` rows (`mlaB` `GO:0050821`, `mlaC` `GO:0120014`/`GO:0005543`) pass the participation test with an explicit non-redundancy argument.
- **Descriptions are clean biological summaries** — no project or workflow framing anywhere.

---

### 🟡 IMPORTANT

**1. `BP3760`: the PMID:40168124 quote does not support any of the four claims it is attached to.**
[`genes/BORPE/BP3760/BP3760-ai-review.yaml:34,60,141,158`](https://github.com/ai4curation/ai-gene-review/blob/cmungall/aigr-mla-taxon-audit/genes/BORPE/BP3760/BP3760-ai-review.yaml#L34)

`supporting_text: significant enrichment of PG over PE` is used as the only PMID:40168124 support for (a) the `GO:0016020` → `GO:0009279 cell outer membrane` MODIFY, (b) the `GO:0120010` ACCEPT, (c) the reference `findings[].statement` "An E. coli porin–MlaA complex directly promotes MlaC lipid loading", and (d) the core function.

In the paper that clause is about the **headgroup composition of MlaC's cargo**, not about MlaA at all:

> Despite similar loading efficiencies for the E. coli phospholipids PE and PG in vitro, we note a significant enrichment of PG over PE in overexpressed and endogenously expressed MlaC…

It says nothing about outer-membrane localization and nothing about the MlaA interface. The module file already picks the correct sentence from the same paper and even records what the PG/PE clause actually means ("Endogenous MlaC is enriched in PG; this does not imply that the carrier accepts only PG", [`modules/…:114-118`](https://github.com/ai4curation/ai-gene-review/blob/cmungall/aigr-mla-taxon-audit/modules/bacterial_mla_intermembrane_phospholipid_transport.yaml#L114)). Re-quote the sentence the module uses:

> We demonstrate that OmpF3–MlaA simultaneously recruits apo MlaC and phospholipids, thus greatly enhancing lipid transfer to MlaC in solution.

[Fix this →](https://claude.ai/code?q=On%20branch%20cmungall%2Faigr-mla-taxon-audit%20in%20ai-gene-review%3A%20in%20genes%2FBORPE%2FBP3760%2FBP3760-ai-review.yaml%2C%20the%20supporting_text%20%22significant%20enrichment%20of%20PG%20over%20PE%22%20from%20PMID%3A40168124%20appears%20at%20lines%2034%2C%2060%2C%20141%20and%20158.%20That%20clause%20is%20about%20MlaC%20cargo%20headgroup%20composition%2C%20not%20about%20MlaA%20localization%20or%20the%20outer-membrane%20interface%2C%20so%20it%20does%20not%20support%20the%20GO%3A0016020-to-GO%3A0009279%20MODIFY%2C%20the%20GO%3A0120010%20ACCEPT%2C%20the%20reference%20finding%20statement%2C%20or%20the%20core%20function.%20Replace%20all%20four%20with%20the%20verbatim%20sentence%20already%20used%20in%20modules%2Fbacterial_mla_intermembrane_phospholipid_transport.yaml%3A%20%22We%20demonstrate%20that%20OmpF3%E2%80%93MlaA%20simultaneously%20recruits%20apo%20MlaC%20and%20phospholipids%2C%20thus%20greatly%20enhancing%20lipid%20transfer%20to%20MlaC%20in%20solution.%22%20Confirm%20it%20is%20verbatim%20against%20publications%2FPMID_40168124.md%2C%20then%20run%20just%20validate%20BORPE%20BP3760%20and%20just%20render%20BORPE%20BP3760.&repo=ai4curation/ai-gene-review)

**2. The published inventory row for this module keeps pre-restructure measured fields.**
[`projects/MODULE_TAXON_AUDIT/inventory.json:4935-4941`](https://github.com/ai4curation/ai-gene-review/blob/cmungall/aigr-mla-taxon-audit/projects/MODULE_TAXON_AUDIT/inventory.json#L4935)

The row's `declared_status`/`audit_status`/`audit_evidence` were updated, but the derived counts were not:

| field | inventory | module as written |
|---|---|---|
| `annotons` | 3 | 4 (3 parts + 2 variants) |
| `annotons_with_family` | 2 | 4 |
| `annotons_with_direct_evidence` | 0 | every part carries evidence |
| `representative_accessions` | `Q88KX6`, `Q88P91` | 18 across 6 families |

The sibling `bacterial_lipoprotein_maturation` row at line 4761 has these regenerated (`annotons_with_direct_evidence: 3`, a longer accession list), so this looks like a missed regeneration rather than a convention. It matters because the inventory renders onto the project page and feeds the browser, so `annotons_with_direct_evidence: 0` understates exactly what this PR added.

[Fix this →](https://claude.ai/code?q=On%20branch%20cmungall%2Faigr-mla-taxon-audit%20in%20ai-gene-review%3A%20the%20bacterial_mla_intermembrane_phospholipid_transport%20row%20in%20projects%2FMODULE_TAXON_AUDIT%2Finventory.json%20(around%20line%204928)%20still%20has%20pre-restructure%20derived%20fields%3A%20annotons%203%2C%20annotons_with_family%202%2C%20annotons_with_direct_evidence%200%2C%20and%20representative_accessions%20listing%20only%20UniProtKB%3AQ88KX6%20and%20UniProtKB%3AQ88P91.%20The%20restructured%20modules%2Fbacterial_mla_intermembrane_phospholipid_transport.yaml%20now%20has%20four%20annotons%20across%20three%20parts%20plus%20two%20variants%2C%20six%20PANTHER%20families%2C%20per-part%20evidence%2C%20and%2018%20representative%20member%20accessions.%20Regenerate%20these%20derived%20fields%20the%20same%20way%20the%20bacterial_lipoprotein_maturation%20row%20near%20line%204761%20was%20regenerated%2C%20leave%20the%20audit_evidence%20block%20alone%2C%20then%20re-render%20the%20project%20pages%20with%20just%20render-projects.&repo=ai4curation/ai-gene-review)

**3. The two zero-annotation proteins get no `NEW` row, which drops the strongest evidence this PR surfaces.**
`genes/PSEAE/ttg2D/ttg2D-ai-review.yaml`, `genes/BORPE/BP3761/BP3761-ai-review.yaml`

Both have empty GOA files, and the notes record a blanket policy: *"No NEW rows were added, including for zero-row proteins."* That's a self-imposed rule, not a GO guideline, and here it suppresses two proposals that clear CLAUDE.md's `NEW` bar comfortably:

- **PSEAE `Q9HVW4`** — PMID:33837253 gives a crystal structure of the mature PAO1 protein plus native MS of cargo recovered from protein *purified from the P. aeruginosa periplasm* (I verified both in the cached text). That is IDA-grade, on the exact target, for a molecular-function binding term.
- **BORPE `Q7VSZ6`** — two deposited structures whose construct I confirmed is an exact match to `Q7VSZ6` 27–207, each with a bound phosphatidylethanolamine.

The gene product itself does the binding, so the participation question doesn't arise, and `GO:0005543` is not a descendant or ancestor of anything these genes carry — they carry nothing. As it stands, `core_functions` asserts the biology but nothing in either file proposes an annotation, so the net curation output for both genes is zero. Proposing `NEW GO:0005543` (and, for `Q9HVW4`, `GO:0030288`) with the existing quotes would cost nothing and is consistent with how `mlaC` handles the same evidence shape.

[Fix this →](https://claude.ai/code?q=On%20branch%20cmungall%2Faigr-mla-taxon-audit%20in%20ai-gene-review%3A%20genes%2FPSEAE%2Fttg2D%2Fttg2D-ai-review.yaml%20and%20genes%2FBORPE%2FBP3761%2FBP3761-ai-review.yaml%20both%20have%20empty%20GOA%20files%20and%20no%20existing_annotations%20at%20all%2C%20because%20the%20notes%20adopted%20a%20blanket%20%22no%20NEW%20rows%20for%20zero-row%20proteins%22%20policy.%20Add%20conservative%20NEW%20rows%20so%20the%20direct%20evidence%20actually%20reaches%20a%20proposal%3A%20for%20Q9HVW4%20propose%20NEW%20GO%3A0005543%20phospholipid%20binding%20and%20GO%3A0030288%20outer%20membrane-bounded%20periplasmic%20space%2C%20supported%20by%20PMID%3A33837253%20(crystal%20structure%20of%20the%20mature%20PAO1%20protein%20plus%20native%20MS%20of%20cargo%20from%20protein%20purified%20from%20the%20P.%20aeruginosa%20periplasm)%3B%20for%20Q7VSZ6%20propose%20NEW%20GO%3A0005543%20supported%20by%20the%20PDB%2011HY%20and%2011IF%20entries%20whose%20construct%20matches%20Q7VSZ6%20residues%2027-207%20with%20a%20bound%20PEF%20ligand.%20Use%20verbatim%20quotes%20checked%20against%20the%20cached%20publications%2C%20mirror%20the%20justification%20style%20of%20the%20NEW%20rows%20in%20genes%2FECOLI%2FmlaC%2FmlaC-ai-review.yaml%2C%20update%20both%20notes%20files%20to%20record%20the%20changed%20policy%2C%20add%20history%20records%20with%20just%20new-history%2C%20then%20run%20just%20validate%20and%20just%20render%20for%20both%20genes.&repo=ai4curation/ai-gene-review)

---

### 🔵 SUGGESTIONS

**4. A two-word quote carries the key primary source for PSEAE ttg2D.** [`genes/PSEAE/ttg2D/ttg2D-ai-review.yaml:19,84`](https://github.com/ai4curation/ai-gene-review/blob/cmungall/aigr-mla-taxon-audit/genes/PSEAE/ttg2D/ttg2D-ai-review.yaml#L19) — `supporting_text: one cardiolipin` is verbatim but asserts nothing on its own, and it is the sole PMID:33837253 quote for both the reference finding and a core function about a four-acyl-chain cavity. The paper offers `"diacyl glycerophospholipids as well as one cardiolipin"` and `"this protein can accommodate four acyl"` a few lines apart.

**5. Boilerplate `review.summary` in the BORPE files.** Seven rows read `"<term label> evaluated against target classification and source-qualified Mla biology."` The `reason` fields underneath are substantive and specific; the summaries just restate the term. Compare the ECOLI summaries ("MlaB binds the MlaF nucleotide-binding domain (MlaFB crystal structure, pull-downs)"), which state the finding.

**6. `relevance: HIGH` on GO_REF method references contradicts their own notes.** e.g. [`BP3757-ai-review.yaml:87-95`](https://github.com/ai4curation/ai-gene-review/blob/cmungall/aigr-mla-taxon-audit/genes/BORPE/BP3757/BP3757-ai-review.yaml#L87) marks `GO_REF:0000002` `relevance: HIGH` while its `review_notes` say it "identifies the mapping method, not an independent target assay". Per the enum, `relevance` is how relevant the reference is to *this gene's function* — that's `LOW` (background/provenance). Elsewhere in the repo (`genes/PSEPK/hscA`) GO_REFs carry no `reference_review` at all.

**7. `related_open_prs` drops a still-open PR.** [`inventory.json:4932`](https://github.com/ai4curation/ai-gene-review/blob/cmungall/aigr-mla-taxon-audit/projects/MODULE_TAXON_AUDIT/inventory.json#L4932) replaces `[5076]` with `[6198]`. PR #5076 is still `OPEN`, and the module's own `notes` discuss its overlap on module labels and MlaB grounding — so it should probably be `[5076, 6198]`.

**8. Consider making the `enables` → `contributes_to` correction machine-readable.** `MARK_AS_OVER_ANNOTATED` is applied to seven `enables GO:0120014` rows on non-carrier subunits (`mlaB` ×2, `mlaD` ×2, `mlaE`, `mlaF` ×2) with `contributes_to_molecular_function` in `core_functions`. The reasoning is sound and consistently applied. But the defect here is the *qualifier*, not the term, and the schema has a slot for exactly that: a `source_defects` entry with `slot: Qualifier`, `asserted_value: enables` → `corrected_value: contributes_to`. Worth noting that `genes/PSEPK/acoA` argues the opposite position explicitly — that an enables-vs-`contributes_to` gap is "not false biology" and shouldn't be `MARK_AS_OVER_ANNOTATED`. Two audits in the same repo reaching opposite conclusions on the same question is worth reconciling, probably at the project level rather than in this PR.

**9. `PTHR30188:SF4` as the MlaE family selector — noting for the record, not as a defect.** The label is verbatim-correct and SF4 is the *only* subfamily in `PTHR30188` containing MlaE, so the choice is forced. The family review is admirably candid that SF4 "mixes cargo and cellular contexts", and the module notes disclose it. The residual risk is that the `FAMILY` selector nominally licenses chloroplast TGD1 and mycobacterial YrbE as realizers of the bacterial inner-membrane step, with only the `context.conditions` prose holding that back. If a narrower grounding ever becomes available (NCBIfam `TIGR00056`/`NF033619` or InterPro `IPR053408 MlaE_Permease` are all present on these entries and are MlaE-specific), it would tighten the module materially.

**10. Quote the UniProt features the BORPE reasons rely on.** `BP3757` cites "PROSITE ABC transporter domain and ATP-binding site 45–52" and `BP3758` cites "RuleBase-supported multipass topology" in prose, with the `file:` reference carrying no `supporting_text`. I checked both against the flat files and they're accurate (`FT BINDING 45..52` / `PS50893`; five RuleBase `FT TRANSMEM` helices). Quoting the `FT`/`DR` lines with `record_section`, as `genes/PSEPK/vacJ` does, would make them checkable by the validator instead of by hand.

---

### Verdict

Requesting changes for 🟡 #1 (a quote that doesn't support four separate claims — concrete and quick), #2 (stale published inventory metrics) and #3 (the zero-row `NEW` policy). None of these touch the core science, which is careful and unusually well evidenced; the evidence-scoping discipline here (assay organism vs. target, deposited structure vs. native flux, family match vs. complete realization) is the strongest part of the PR and I found no case where it overreached.
 · [Branch](https://github.com/ai4curation/ai-gene-review/tree/cmungall/aigr-mla-taxon-audit)

reviews.body:
Requesting changes on three fixable points; the core science is careful and well evidenced.

Verified independently (all held up):
- PDB 11HY/11IF polymer entities are MAHHHHHH + an exact 181-residue match to Q7VSZ6 residues 27-207, each with a PEF (DPPE) ligand.
- Every PANTHER id/label pair is verbatim-correct against interpro/panther/panther.obo, and every representative_members accession is confirmed in its own UniProt PANTHER cross-reference. The one exception, Q88P90 (PSEPK Ttg2E), is exactly as the module description says: the cached flatfile predates the assignment and the frozen family-consultation snapshot carries PTHR35849:SF1.
- GO:1990531 -> GO:0043190 is correct (P4-ATPase flippase complex vs ABC transporter complex), and the GO:0120014 definition quoted in the reasons matches the frozen QuickGO payload word for word.
- All 7 new publication files are machine-fetched with matching titles; ~12 supporting_text quotes spot-checked verbatim, including one spanning a line wrap.
- Protein-binding REMOVEs follow policy with the interaction preserved in reason; the NEW rows (mlaB GO:0050821, mlaC GO:0120014/GO:0005543) pass the participation test with explicit non-redundancy arguments; descriptions are clean biological summaries.

IMPORTANT:
1. genes/BORPE/BP3760/BP3760-ai-review.yaml lines 34, 60, 141, 158 - the PMID:40168124 quote 'significant enrichment of PG over PE' is about MlaC cargo headgroup composition, not MlaA localization or the outer-membrane interface. It is used as the sole support for the GO:0016020 -> GO:0009279 MODIFY, the GO:0120010 ACCEPT, the reference finding statement and the core function. The module file already selects the correct sentence from the same paper ('We demonstrate that OmpF3-MlaA simultaneously recruits apo MlaC and phospholipids, thus greatly enhancing lipid transfer to MlaC in solution.') and even records what the PG/PE clause actually means.
2. projects/MODULE_TAXON_AUDIT/inventory.json lines 4935-4941 keep pre-restructure derived fields (annotons 3, annotons_with_family 2, annotons_with_direct_evidence 0, two representative accessions) for a module that now has four annotons across three parts plus two variants, six PANTHER families and 18 representative members. The sibling bacterial_lipoprotein_maturation row has these regenerated, so this looks like a missed regeneration, and it renders onto the project page.
3. The blanket 'no NEW rows, including for zero-row proteins' policy leaves PSEAE ttg2D (Q9HVW4) and BORPE BP3761 (Q7VSZ6) with no proposed annotation at all, despite carrying the strongest direct evidence in the PR: native-host periplasmic purification plus native MS and a crystal structure for Q9HVW4, and two ligand-bound deposited structures of the exact mature sequence for Q7VSZ6. Both clear the NEW bar for a molecular-function binding term.

Suggestions (non-blocking) are detailed in the review comment: a two-word 'one cardiolipin' quote carrying the key PSEAE source, boilerplate review.summary text in the BORPE files, relevance: HIGH on GO_REF method references contradicting their own review_notes, PR #5076 dropped from related_open_prs while still open, making the enables -> contributes_to correction machine-readable via source_defects slot: Qualifier (and reconciling it with the opposite position taken in genes/PSEPK/acoA), the PTHR30188:SF4 family-scope note, and quoting the UniProt FT/DR features the BORPE reasons rely on.

Note: I could not run just validate in this environment (uv unavailable, python3 blocked), so deterministic checks are left to CI, which was still in progress. Everything above was verified by reading the frozen artifacts, panther.obo, the UniProt flat files and the cached publications directly.
